apps.title: espp Core Dump Console (WebUSB / Web Serial)
apps.description: Inspect ESP-IDF flash core dumps in the browser: crash summary, ELF core dump download, client-side nearest-symbol backtrace resolution and erase, over WebUSB or Web Serial via the espp coredump component.

apps.title: espp Desktop (WebUSB / Web Serial)
apps.description: A windowed desktop for an espp device, rendered entirely in the browser from the widget tree the firmware's desktop component streams over WebUSB or Web Serial: apps, windows, widgets, dialogs and notifications.

apps.title: espp Device Hub (WebUSB / Web Serial)
apps.description: Connect to an espp device over USB (WebUSB / Web Serial) and discover which modules it runs. The device answers a capability query on the reserved dispatcher discovery module (0xFF) with its name, firmware, and the list of modules — each shown as a tab that links to its hosted web app.

apps.title: espp OTA Console (WebUSB)
apps.description: Update espp device firmware over WebUSB: streams a .bin to the espp ota component's vendor-interface protocol with progress and rollback-aware finish.

apps.title: espp System Console (WebUSB / Web Serial)
apps.description: Device info, reboot and reboot-into-bootloader plus live heap and task statistics for an espp device, over WebUSB or Web Serial via the espp system and monitor components.

apps.title: Basicmicro MCP Console
apps.description: Test and configure Basicmicro MCP/RoboClaw motor controllers over a USB-UART (packet serial) or USB-CAN (slcan + CANopen/DS402) adapter: device info, motion control, encoders, and an SDO object browser.

apps.title: espp BLDC Haptics Console (WebUSB)
apps.description: Control and visualize an espp BLDC haptic knob over WebUSB: live dial, detent presets, and control commands. Firmware update and crash inspection are separate modules (see the ota / coredump consoles via the device hub).

apps.title: espp DS402 Drive Panel (WebUSB / Web Serial)
apps.description: Commission a CANopen CiA 402 (DS402) drive over a USB-to-CAN bridge from the browser: SDO object read/write, the DS402 state machine, mode selection, target/actual values, an object-dictionary browser (the device's stored EDS, an EDS file, or the built-in CiA 301/402 table, scanned over SDO), and a generic read/write panel for vendor-specific addresses.

apps.title: espp MCP266 Console (WebUSB / Web Serial)
apps.description: Configure, command, and monitor a Basicmicro MCP266 dual-channel motor controller from the browser over USB (WebUSB / Web Serial): per-axis position loop setup, profile-position moves, and live status. The device runs the CANopen driver and exposes a high-level protocol.

apps.title: ODrive ASCII Web Serial Console
apps.description: Web Serial console for the ODrive ASCII protocol: interactive terminal, quick motor controls, and live position/velocity plotting.

apps.title: ODrive ASCII WebUSB Console
apps.description: WebUSB console speaking the ODrive ASCII protocol over the vendor bulk interface (no serial driver needed).

apps.title: ODrive Native WebUSB Control Panel
apps.description: WebUSB control panel for the ODrive native (Fibre) binary protocol: endpoint tree browser, live multi-signal plots, and quick controls.

apps.title: CAN Bus Console (slcan)
apps.description: Generic CAN bus console for slcan (LAWICEL) USB-CAN adapters over Web Serial: send standard/extended/RTR frames, periodic transmits, live per-ID monitoring, and log export.

apps.title: espp CAN Bridge Console (WebUSB / Web Serial)
apps.description: Drive a USB-to-CAN bridge device over WebUSB or Web Serial: configure the bus, send CAN frames, and watch a live monitor of received traffic using the espp stream_frame protocol.

apps.title: WebHID Gamepad Input Visualizer
apps.description: WebHID input visualizer: connect any HID gamepad or device and watch its decoded buttons, sticks, and raw input reports live.

apps.title: espp Board Console & ESP Flasher
apps.description: General-purpose Web Serial board console and ESP flasher (esptool-js): serial monitor, reset/bootloader controls, and firmware flashing.

apps.title: espp Serial Plotter
apps.description: Data plotter: auto-parses columnar serial output over Web Serial, or plots binary telemetry (espp::Telemetry) over WebUSB. Efficient high-point-count plots (uPlot), per-series filter, CSV save/load, and optional 2D X-Y / 3D X-Y-Z modes.
